description: This file implements platform-specific DNS configuration watcher for macOS, utilizing dynamic loading of system libraries to access DNS configuration symbols and providing functions to watch for DNS configuration changes and check DNS configuration status.

classes.name: DnsInfoApi
classes.description: Encapsulates dynamic loading of DNS configuration symbols from system libraries on macOS.

classes.name: DnsConfigTDeleter
classes.description: Custom deleter for dns_config_t objects, calling the appropriate free function.

methods.name: GetDnsInfoApi
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of DnsInfoApi with loaded DNS symbols.

methods.name: DnsConfigWatcher::Watch
methods.description: Sets up a watcher for DNS configuration changes, invoking a callback upon change.

methods.name: DnsConfigWatcher::CheckDnsConfig
methods.description: Checks the current DNS configuration for unhandled options, returning success status and output parameter.
